alt: Ovary, uterine tube and uterus with the follicle cycle. Left: an oocyte leaves the ovary, is swept into the uterine tube and cleaves as it travels to the uterine cavity, where the blastocyst implants in the endometrium. Right: follicles of increasing size (the largest with a fluid-filled antrum), a corpus luteum, and the fertilisation-to-blastocyst sequence. Servier Medical Art.
